summary: Gates that read domain authority files use a hybrid trust model: detector code, path mapping, schemas, transforms and verdict logic come from base; domain authority content comes from head as candidate input and is compared with base by role at JSON Pointer granularity. target-declaration content is validated for schema, references and consistency without authorization; governing-policy and exception-authorization changes must be mechanically proven tightening or equivalent, otherwise they require a Plan 06 section 12 weaken-policy authorization and fail closed until P4 provides that channel; derived-projection files are regenerated by the base generator from head authority in a temporary directory and must pass hash, schema, parity and monotonicity checks before they may drive a verdict; evidence stays under historical integrity.
rationale: P2 analysis found that the G03, G04, G05, Plan04 and database detectors read domain-owned authority outside the guard package (for example the G03 contract-event catalog, deployment/g04 manifests and Plan04 policies), while the CP02 trust contracts named only V3_ifx/policy. Reading those files from base would force every contract or deployment change into two PRs; trusting head unconditionally would let a PR relax its own policy or add waivers. Pre risks and CODEOWNERS routing only provide visibility because ruleset approval is not enforced (deferred item O1), so anti-weakening must come from base comparison, monotonicity and section 12 authorization. Roles are assigned per JSON Pointer because files such as the G03 catalog mix declarations with lifecycle, enforcement and ownership fields. With D13's zero-comparator start, only governing-policy and exception-authorization changes need authorization, so normal declaration changes remain single PRs. A candidate projection may drive a verdict only after the anti-weakening checks pass; if they fail the gate fails rather than falling back to the base projection. Until P4 implements weaken-policy authorization, such changes fail closed and the only exception path is the external break-glass in Plan 06 section 11.7. Source: Codex hybrid-model review with Claude refinements, approved by the user on 2026-09-17; refines D9 and D13.
